Wizardry Empire - Fukkatsu no Tsue.summary: Wizardry Empire: Staff of Resurrection is a 2000 role-game released exclusivley in Japan by Starfish Inc. The game is very similar to other games in the series with staples such as recruiting a party than dungeon crawling in first person.
